title: Fontaine–Mazur modularity at the prime 2
summary: We prove that every continuous, irreducible, odd two-dimensional 2-adic representation of $`G_{\mathbb Q}`$, unramified outside finitely many primes and de Rham at 2 with distinct Hodge–Tate weights, is modular up to Tate twist. This resolves the odd, regular two-dimensional Fontaine–Mazur conjecture over ℚ at 2, including all residual representations.
family_title: Unrestricted pro-modularity at the prime two

review.reason: Proves modularity of certain 2-adic Galois representations, addressing the Fontaine–Mazur conjecture at prime 2.

discussion.title: A Brief Digest of Some New OpenAI Results | Persiflage
discussion.author: Persiflage
discussion.text: It is very clean, which is useful for applications. That said, upon closer inspection this paper may turn out to have some really clever new trick, but I can’t see what that is on a superficial reading. I would actually say I’m surprised that this is a problem OpenAI would have tried to solve,…
